title: Entitled Woman Turns Hospital Appointment into Felony Charges
description:
On May 5th, 2020, officers responded to a disorderly woman at a hospital. Initially, she complained about the delay in her son’s test results, but then she began assaulting the nurse when the nurse asked her to follow COVID-19 protocols by waiting outside instead of in the waiting room. Here’s what happened when the police arrived. She was stubborn and even went on to resist the officers' commands, which led to a huge chaos. This is when she went berserk and began hitting the officer. The woman was taken to the hospital for a checkup. She was charged with resisting with violence, trespass and battery upon a peace officer.
